digest.component_or_area: Git hook installation and pre-commit integration
propositions: The documented curl command for installing the commit-msg hook resolves to the shared hooks directory and overwrites the pre-commit wrapper identically across all worktrees on a host, destroying Change-Id stamping silently.

When a pre-commit wrapper manages commit-msg and is overwritten by a bare Gerrit hook install, the pre-commit gate (50/72 message rule) stops running and Change-Id stamping becomes orphaned, causing failures only at git push time potentially many commits later.

The install-gerrit-hook.sh script must be worktree-safe by resolving git-common-dir absolutely, non-destructive by installing to commit-msg.legacy when a pre-commit wrapper owns the commit-msg slot, idempotent so make hooks can call it repeatedly, and loud by refusing unsafe overwrites instead of silently succeeding.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md document an unsafe bare curl over git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg that must be removed in favor of make hooks as the single documented installation path.
The fix consolidates Gerrit hook installation into make hooks, which already owns the pre-commit chaining arrangement and can verify that Change-Id stamping survives installation.
